meta.title: Santa Barbara Superior Court appointed-counsel billing guidelines (FC-3150, 2026-04-22)
meta.licence: No licence stated. Government/public-institution publication posted on the open web; used only as a public document for internal evaluation, not redistributed.
meta.pii_note: Public document from an agency or court; counts only, no matched text recorded. Hits: email 1, case_party_marker 1. Hits are agency contact details, addresses and generic role words, not private individuals.

pii_scan.disposition: Business and agency contact details only; no private-person data expected. Safe for local evaluation use.

rules.paraphrase: Fixed hourly rates of 100 dollars for attorneys and 50 dollars for attorney support staff.
Bill actual time only, rounded up to the nearest tenth of an hour.
Court or waiting time shared by several appointed cases must be allocated across them and not billed in full to each.
No bundling of services: each legal task is itemised and multiple activities are not listed under one time allotment.

keywords: travel to and from place of business to court

rules.paraphrase: Travel time between the place of business and court is not reimbursable.
One claim per case monthly; claims for completed work within 30 days and no later than 60 days or payment is at risk.
Expenses are not ordinarily reimbursed unless reasonable, necessary and pre-approved by the court.
Claim packet includes a detailed invoice using the word client instead of party names, and Form FL-323.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: Fiscal-year-end invoices are submitted within ten days after June 30.
The judge may limit amounts deemed excessive.
